reason: The hold says the UI criterion has no end-to-end test, but e2e/test_m8_ref_carry_grants.py holds three tests tagged C-b8363cd2 whose assertions match the scenario's THEN clauses for the 403, 500 and 401 cases exactly as the browser test plan lists them.
